thread:
maria-support: FYI Acme support ticket - embeddings vectors/sec dropped ~3x starting ~02:15 UTC. tokens/sec looks steady. Users hit higher p99 latency and occasional 400/422 on some batched requests. attaching quick perf link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/embeddings?panel=vec-rate :eyes:
kevin-sre: Can you paste a request id or example? Which pool/region?
lucas-runtime: saw this on us-west-2 dedicated pool gw-23. GPU util ~96-99% on node set rgx-g4x-8, queue depth spiked to ~110 requests. Vectors/sec dropped while tokens/sec unchanged.
anna-ml: any recent model variants or rollout? dimension mismatch errors (422) could indicate a fallback to a wrong model shape.
maria-support: example request ids from customer: r-84a3, r-84a7. They reported "embedding length mismatch" in some responses. I'll paste a trimmed debug response: 
```
{"request_id":"r-84a3","status":200,"embedding_len":512}
{"request_id":"r-84a7","status":422,"error":"embedding dimension 768 != expected 512"}
```
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T01:58Z: rollout "batching-defaults-v2" -> service: embeddings-runtime (sha: b7c9d3f)
kevin-sre: aha - deploy at 01:58 aligns with customer start. lucas, can you grep for rollout -> kvcache/kv_batch config changes?
lucas-runtime: looking now. quick grep shows config change: default_max_batch_size  = 64 -> 128, prefer_latency toggled off -> batching favors throughput. Also a fallback map added that maps some older model ids to quantized-compat variant (dim 768).
anna-ml: that mismatch explains the 422s. But why vectors/sec falls while tokens/sec steady? my hypothesis: larger batch sizes push batch formation latency up when queue depth oscillates, causing GPUs to saturate on a few large huge-batches, increasing per-token scheduling overhead and killing overall vector throughput due to KV cache churn.
kevin-sre: monitoring: kvcache miss rate jumped from 4% -> 27% after deploy. queue depth median jumped 3x. p95 latency for embeddings from 120ms -> 720ms on affected pool.
maria-support: customer is asking for mitigation now. Any quick workaround?
lucas-runtime: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback batching-defaults-v2 (fast) 2) pin the customer's routing to model-512 variant (force correct dim) 3) reduce max_batch_size to 32 and enable prefer_latency.
kevin-sre: I can roll back the deploy but we should be careful - rollout also included unrelated perf fixes. prefer option 2 for targeted fix while we triage. maria, can you ask customer if they can be routed to model-512?
maria-support: pinged customer, they can accept routing change. Doing that now.
alert-bot: Routing change applied for customer acme-corp -> model-512 (effective 02:42 UTC).
lucas-runtime: after routing change, their error rate 422->0 for their requests. vectors/sec for their shard recovered to ~85% of baseline but cluster-wide vectors/sec still degraded.
anna-ml: cluster-wide effect likely due to default config change. We need an infra mitigation: revert batching-defaults-v2 or patch config to keep prefer_latency true and lower default_max_batch_size to 48.
kevin-sre: I'll open a rollback PR and a hotfix PR and coordinate. PR numbers: rollback: https://git.internal/r/redwood/embeddings-runtime/pulls/4321, hotfix: /pulls/4322. Targeting rollback in 15m if no objections.
maria-support: customer confirmed immediate improvement after routing change, they're okay with short rollback window as long as we notify.
lucas-runtime: also noticed increased tail GPU memory alloc churn in logs; paste sample log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-17T02:08:14Z] node=rgx-g4x-8-11 queueDepth=114 batchSize=128 kvcache_miss=0.29 gpu_util=0.98 evict_count=42
[2026-03-17T02:08:15Z] oom_protect=false batch_flush=forced latency_ms=1024
```
anna-ml: action items: 1) rollback or hotfix to restore prefer_latency + smaller batches 2) audit fallback map to prevent dim-mismatches by model id 3) add regression alert that ties kvcache_miss and queue_depth combos to vectors/sec drops
kevin-sre: starting rollback now. will post when complete.
deploy-bot: Rollback started (rollback of batching-defaults-v2) at 02:55 UTC by kevin-sre.
kevin-sre: rollback finished at 02:59 UTC. preliminary metrics show queue depth down to baseline, kvcache_miss ~6%, vectors/sec trending back up.
maria-support: customer reports p99 latency back to normal and no more dim errors. :tada:
lucas-runtime: follow-ups: revert fallback mapping change in next release and add unit test that verifies embedding dims for all model id mappings. I'll file the tickets.
anna-ml: also recommend adding a short canary that samples embed responses post-rollout and fails fast if dimension mismatch or kvcache_miss spikes.
kevin-sre: thanks team. i'll keep monitor on for the next 2 hours. :eyes:
